title: JackPotX
description: JackPotX is a lightweight and secure Minecraft jackpot mini-game that’s highly configurable, runs on automatic timers or admin control, and features colorful countdowns, particle and effects.
body:
# 📦 __JackPotX__

JackPotX is a vibrant and secure Minecraft jackpot mini-game that runs timed jackpot events and automatically rewards winners.
It is highly configurable and overall amazing and fun.

## ✨ __Features__

- **Automatic jackpots** – runs on timers defined in **config.yml.**
- **Manual jackpots** – admins can control jackpots at any time.
- **Colorful countdowns** – rainbow countdowns in chat and action bar.
- **Scramble animation** – vibrant colored dust particles at entrants’ feet.
- **Configurable rewards** – winners receive commands/items defined in config.
- **Console banner** – colorful startup banner with plugin name, version, and author.
- **Secure & stable** – no backdoors, no exploits, permission-gated admin tools.

## ⚙️ __Configuration__

- **Timers:** entry timer, scramble duration, automatic start times.
- **Rewards:** set commands or items to give to winners.
- **Messages:** all jackpot messages are customizable and color-codeable.
# ⌨️ Commands 
## 🎮 __Player Commands__

- **/jackpot** – to enter the Jackpot.
- **/jackpot help** – Get detailed info about the current jackpot.

## ⌨️ __Admin Commands__ (/jackpotadmin …)
- **/jackpotadmin start** - force start a jackpot.
- **/jackpotadmin stop** – Stop the ongoing jackpot.
- **/jackpotadmin rewardadd** – Add the item in your hand to the rewards.
- **/jackpotadmin rewardaddcmd** <command> – Add a console command reward (use %player% as placeholder).
- **/jackpotadmin rewardlist** – List all configured rewards.
- **/jackpotadmin rewardremove** <index> – Remove a reward by its index.
- **/jackpotadmin setinterval** <seconds> – Set the auto-start interval in seconds.
- **/jackpotadmin settimer** <seconds> – Set the entry timer in seconds.

## 🔑 __Permissions__

- **jackpot.admin** – Grants access to all admin commands (default: OP).
- Player commands require no special permission.
